entry_points.text: Boot zeroes committed counter with fatal check, registers vm sysctls and area cache, plus hotplug reserve maintainer logging failure but reporting success.
Emits lock start, acquisition result with success flag, and release, each distinguishing read versus write mode.
Takes context guard, returns covering area or grows growsdown with demote; prefers promotion else release-reacquire; second variant keeps guard only when found.
Interval release walks full span blockable with two-phase start and queued finish or single-phase; top start prefers interval then classic list.
Plain and keyed protection forward to driver; key alloc rejects flags and out-of-mask bits, allocates under guard with rollback; key free releases under guard.

exports.text: Adds prepared area after overlap and accountable checks, deriving anon offsets from start and publishing with bumped count; failure reverts charges.
Lookup reuses by ops or allocates then registers; removal releases under RCU read, unlinks, waits; put reclaims last ref with saturating counts; plus global sync.
Range insert validates span and live ref, links or queues during active invalidation with odd seq; removal unlinks or cancels, waits for seq advance, drops ref.
Fixes one area then walks contiguous span under write guard, enforcing contiguity, perm subset, sealed and accounting checks, updating flags/tables/stats together.
Young queries OR clear results over span under SRCU, single-address test stops at first positive; secondary invalidate invokes arch callback where present.

hazards.text: Partial fork truncates new store at failure: zero areas unmaps nothing, mid-tree unmaps to failing start, full write unmaps all; failing mm hides from OOM, marks unstable.
Read-to-write upgrade never succeeds; callers must always handle failure with explicit release and reacquire.
Classic range start warns on failure expecting retry indication when nonblocking and forbidding end on failing party while ending succeeded parties.
Clearing unset bulk markers or destroying non-empty subscription collections is fatal.

invariants.text: Linking is all-or-nothing: file association, count increment, validation on success; reservation failure links nothing and reports nomem.
Area cache for one descriptor with embedded free pointer, sheaf 32, line alignment, panic-on-fail, RCU-safe reclaim; unit instantiates lock tracepoints.
User and admin reserves each take 1/32 of free kilobytes clamped to SZ_128K and SZ_8K ceilings respectively.
Fork copies counters/store, drops dontcopy with stat fixup, validates charging, clones policy/anon with wipeonfork empty, inserts file areas after parent under mapping guard.
Child anon reuses or creates structure with one active area, pinned root, COW destination, RCU visibility; detached alloc ref one self-rooted; userfault shares one ctx per original.
Nommu growth always fails; single-page removal uses folio batcher; SMP sync no-ops, RCU free unwraps then frees, explicit sync waits; batch flushes on failure or full.
Range ends inclusive rejecting empty/overflow with extra ref and predecessor-or-odd seq, warning with no live users; successor unwraps next; destroy needs empty then poisons.
No-access precheck approves only when frame permits; table populate is needed solely in write-protect marker path, otherwise skipped.
Old lookup nulls on missing/bad without alloc; new allocates upper levels expecting no huge leaf; move batch singles unless large folio; soft-dirty preserved; move framing truncated.

locks.text: Faults use read guard when read-only or inside, else need growsdown then write guard with downgrade; careful path checks exception table before blocking; upgrade always fails.
Duplication nests killable source then dest guards with flush; take-all takes global mutex, marks areas, locks huge/file/anon aborting on signal; per-object nests once, missing marker fatal.
Area exclusion flags refcount under write guard, waits killable or uninterruptibly for drain to one or zero when detaching, succeeding if detached; start publishes seq ordered.
Next-area lookup speculates under RCU with seq validation retrying on detach and revalidating shrink/insert; fallback uses read guard then re-enters RCU; overflow or detach yields EAGAIN.
Registration needs exclusive guard and live users, lazily inits subscriptions seq two with release publish, rejecting secondary-plus-range combos; invalidating is odd seq under spin.
Classic release and range-end iterate under SRCU with nonblocking marks; top release dispatches interval or list, top end uses validation map, closes interval, runs ends.
Remap acquires file mapping guard then anon when present and releases in reverse order.

state_machines.text: Hotplug always succeeds: online refreshes reserves only when below ceiling; offline recomputes free and resets exceeding reserves with log; others no-op.
Fork success emits one event per original userfault ctx with new address in reserved field and sync wait; failure drops pendings with counter decrement, ref drops, frees, no events.
Single table free defers via RCU callback unwrapping then freeing in one build and syncs immediately then frees in another; wrapper selects active variant.
Start bumps active count, marks odd on overlap, returns first overlap; end drops count, when last odd advances to even applying queue and waking; invalidate two-phase, nonblocking-only retry.
Resize moves invalid to equal, shrink, or expand by comparing old and new lengths; equal permits no-op when no movement requested.

structs.text: Takes area pointer, sleep state killable or uninterruptible, and detaching flag; reports detached indicator and whether exclusive ownership was achieved.
Holds notify list, interval-use flag, spin guard, seq plus active count, cached interval root, wait queue, and deferred update list.
Remap carrier groups addrs, lens, flags, dest, fault ctx, unmap lists, located area, len diff, populate, resize, guard, accounting, invalid flags; resize invalid/equal/shrink/expand.
No-access walk pairs normal and huge checkers requesting exclusive locking; normal approves only when frame permits; huge has checking and absent builds.
Vm max_map_count 0644 zero-min plus arch-gated legacy and 0600 rand widths; batch free 512; growth bits exclusive with personality exec, key-mask checks; page ranges, wrap as nomem.
